new='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_col = next(i for i in range(w) if len({row[i] for row in grid}) == 1)
    left = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
    shared = {v for row in left for v in row} & {v for row in right for v in row}
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if x == color and y == color else color for x, y in zip(a, b)] for a, b in zip(left, right)]
'''
